answer: Forge each agent identity from a unique copper ingot bought from a licensed smelter: its serial is engraved into the identity record, and the smelter trellis logs every sale, capping how many ingots any buyer can take per epoch. Standing needs re-verification against that ledger, while random dune audits sweep the registry, re-checking ingots and melting down fakes. A sybil attacker must pay full retail for one ingot per fake identity, with no bulk discount and no way to copy a serial, so a fake army's cost grows strictly linearly while honest agents pay once and keep their standing.
